slides.title: Most firms don't need [a full-time] brand manager.
slides.lede: For firms of 50–200 people, a fractional brand lead often covers all the brand work there is.

slides.title: When a full-time hire [starts to pay]
slides.text: A week of brand work. With £90,000 a year all-in against £700 a day, break-even is about 129 days a year.

slides.title: A brand with no named owner [still has one]
slides.text: It is whoever last had the file open: usually the managing director, a partner with a view, or a junior with a deadline.

slides.title: Deciding the brand [is not making it]

cards.label: Fractional brand manager
cards.text: Owns positioning, voice and consistency. Briefs and judges the agency.

cards.label: Agency
cards.text: Produces identity, design and campaigns for a project.

items.title: Month one
items.text: A signed register of who decides what.

items.title: Month three
items.text: Win and loss interviews show what buyers believed.

slides.title: Signs the work [fills the week]
slides.note: If partners disagree on what the firm is for, **hire neither yet**. Agree positioning first.
